existing_measured_window.typical_dated_repo: 12 months before that repo's adoption month through 2026-10
existing_measured_window.note: Pre-2024 points are sparse leftovers in three artefacts, not a complete 4-year panel. Most dated repos start at adoption-minus-12-months.

requires: Re-clone the 46 public repos (clones were not kept with this package; ~52 GB)
Pass each repo's already-dated adoption month with --adoption YYYY-MM
A --since flag or AuditConfig.since override — published CLI exposes --baseline 3|6|12|24 and --adoption, not --since

estimated_cost.prior_round_cpu_hours: 12h46m summed audit time at ~24-month windows, 3-way parallel, 150m timeout
estimated_cost.four_year_multiplier_doc: audit-core docs/date-independent-ledger.md estimates ~2.32x time for a full-history vs 12-month-baseline walk
estimated_cost.four_year_ballpark: roughly 25-30 CPU-hours and a few dollars of judge spend if the same plugins run

limitations: Adoption dating still uses AI-marked commits (a floor). Unmarked AI use remains unknown.
A 4-year chart still cannot identify AI as the cause — it can only show whether the 2024-2026 rise continues a longer pre-AI slope.
